**Question 5: Whether the "preliminary test[s]" referred to in paragraphs 10.4 to 10.11 of my 1st Witness Statement were tests of the FAS after power had been restored**

5.1 In paragraphs 10.4 to 10.11 of my 1st Witness Statement, I had discussed the post-fire investigation carried out by FSD in all [FSD/D(III)/4] eight blocks of Wang Fuk Court on 26-27 November 2025, during which occasion, preliminary tests were performed on the Fire Alarm Systems (“FAS”) in all of those blocks except for two, viz. Wang Tai House (Block E) and Wang Cheong House (Block F) (see paragraphs 10.8 to 10.9 of my 1st Witness Statement).
